description: Finite daemon-style operation policy for calendar-gated paper watch batches.
required_behavior: Daemon execution must be finite through max_batches.
Each batch must run the profile-backed paper watch runner and preserve checkpoint/watch-state duplicate controls.
Calendar/session gates must be evaluated before scheduler execution in every tick.
Each batch must be appended to a JSONL daily log with a final daemon summary record.
The daemon remains paper-only and must not submit, stage, preview, transmit, or mutate a real portfolio.
